reason: E1–E3 directly support the SCCP strategy, coherent interface mechanism, and high-temperature strength retention in a tungsten-based HEA, but the cited evidence only demonstrates ambient-temperature ductility and strength at 800 °C, not improved high-temperature plasticity/toughness or nanoprecipitate stability at 1000 °C. E4–E5 concern a different alloy system and a brittle sigma phase, providing no support for the key premises.
